integrity: The algebraic rank cases were derived from the quotient multiplication law; the independent PBW enumeration and exact counts were reproduced. The literature comparisons concern explicit invariants and recognize the previously known primitive-cube specialization.
scientific_limitations: Only the two-generator cubic quantum complete intersections are classified; the generic primitive-cube-root case was already known; no claim of priority over inaccessible or unindexed historical work. Finite numerical checks are supplementary to the proof.
title: The fourth-root rank gap in cubic quantum complete intersections
